spellbook.finance/limitations: Only the latest daily Pokemon ATH snapshot is retained; an unavailable requested date names that limitation.
Prices are TCGCSV market observations. The response does not establish an independent market consensus, a buy signal or a sell signal.
Rows with incomplete retained history remain omitted and are named through coverage, missingFields or limitations.

description: Read the latest Pokemon all-time-high facts for the retained daily snapshot. Rows preserve exact product identity, language, finish, variant, source date, previous ATH and history coverage. This is a facts-only read; unavailable or partial history stays explicit in availability, missingFields and limitations.

date.description: Optional retained snapshot date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to read the latest snapshot.

game.description: The game to read. Must be pokemon.

name: spellbook_pokemon_ath
